ns2:course.label: Process Management
ns2:course.description: Introductory course in decision-making problems in production; includes the theoretical foundations for production management as well as the applications of decision-making techniques to production problems in the firm; and considers production processes, plant layout, maintenance, scheduling, quality control, and production control in particular. Prerequisite: First year of the MBA program or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: First year of the MBA program or equivalent.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MBA:Exec MBA Ilini Ctr-UIUC.
